source_text: Οἱ ἅγιοι μάρτυρες δοξάσαντες τὸν θεόν, ἐξελθόντες ἐπὶ τὸν συνήθη τόπον ἀπετμήθησαν τὰς κεφαλάς, καὶ ἐτελείωσαν αὐτῶν τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἐν τῇ τοῦ σωτῆρος ὁμολογίᾳ. Τινὲς δὲ τῶν πιστῶν λαθραίως αὐτῶν τὰ σώματα λαβόντες κατέθεντο ἐν τόπῳ ἐπιτηδείῳ, συνεργασάσης αὐτοῖς τῆς χάριτος τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ· ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων, ἀμήν.
thought_title: Execution and burial of the witnesses
orientation: After Rusticus sentences them to scourging and beheading, the narrator reports what happened.
pass_a_gloss: The holy martyrs, having glorified God, having gone out to the usual place, were cut off as to their heads, and they completed their witness in the confession of the Savior. But some of the faithful, having taken their bodies secretly, laid them down in a suitable place, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ having worked together with them; to whom be the glory into the ages of the ages, amen.

choices.why: brief glossary fixes this sense for public witness sealed by suffering

choices.english: in the confession of the Savior
choices.why: brief glossary fixes ὁμολογία as open I-am-a-Christian declaration

choices.english: were cut off as to their heads
choices.why: keeps literal accusative of respect instead of smoothing to single verb

choices.english: the grace having worked together with them
choices.why: genitive absolute with dative companion keeps who helps whom

pass_b_english: The holy martyrs glorified God. They went out to the usual place and were beheaded, and in the confession of the Savior they completed their witness.
Some of the faithful secretly took their bodies and laid them in a suitable place, with the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ working with them. To him be glory forever and ever, amen.
